primary_comparison: calibrated_gbt minus matched_raw_gbt daily equal-asset log loss
decision_rule: Predictive improvement needs negative paired mean log-loss difference, negative upper 95% seven-day block-bootstrap bound, and improvement in at least two of three folds. Trading suitability additionally needs net improvement over existing strategy with nontrivial entries under normal/double costs; cash/no-trades is not a winning strategy. No promotion without new prospective evidence and QD review.
search_policy: One calibration method, one fixed model specification, no outcome-driven threshold or hyperparameter search. Report all comparisons and sensitivity cases, including negatives.
